body:
SEI and Carlyle expand their partnership with a multi-asset interval fund offering exposure to private equity, credit, real estate and secondaries.

Previous Post ### LODAS Markets adds industry vets Dellorso, Olivo to drive expansionNext Post ### CPP Investments’ private markets deals total $13.9bn in and after FY27 Q2

p: SEI와 Carlyle이 사모펀드, 사모대출, 부동산, 세컨더리에 대한 투자 기회를 제공하는 멀티에셋 인터벌 펀드를 통해 파트너십을 확대한다.
